reciprocity.lede: {village} is built on reciprocity, and there's more than one way to be valued here.

thanks.heading: Your proposal is with us
thanks.body: Thank you for offering your gifts to {village}. A reply can take up to a month, and there's room to talk it through and revise.

email.subject: We've received your proposal
email.body: Thank you for offering your gifts. We read every Work With Us proposal with care. Please allow up to a month for a thoughtful response, and room for conversation and revision.
